description: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development & Cultural Affairs - The Registration of Persons (Amendment) Regulations - 2015
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by a Minister under the Registration of Persons Act, No. 32 of 1968. It amends existing regulations regarding identity card photographs, photographer registration requirements, fees, and forms. This content involves legal/regulatory matters - specifically statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation that modify existing regulatory frameworks, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
